co_frameworks: SR 11-7 (legacy baseline, superseded by SR 26-2 for agentic components)
CTRL_MRM_004.description: Traditional quantitative model validation criteria applicable to non-agentic, deterministic ML components (e.g. CBF predictor, DoWhy causal model coefficients). SR 26-2 explicitly retains MRM scope for these components.

CTRL_FTRA_001.primary_framework: NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.2 – Risk Tolerance and Commencement Controls
CTRL_FTRA_001.description: Forward-Looking Trajectory Reachability Analyzer (FTRA) — Tier 0.5 governance gate. Performs commencement-time reachability analysis before any trade execution plan is committed. Verifies that the proposed execution trajectory is reachable from the current system state without violating safety constraints. Unreachable or constraint-violating plans are parked in DeferQueue for HITL review.
